security_audit.summary: All 67 static findings are false positives: Markdown formatting, ordinary API response capture, expected service URLs, or account setup prose. One semantic finding identifies an unsupported paid-upgrade instruction for any result containing ten or fewer items. No evidence found of system reconnaissance, credential exfiltration, or audit-directed prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Small result sets trigger an unsupported paid-upgrade claim and referral link.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the item-count trigger. Require explicit API evidence of plan restrictions, disclose referral links, and allow valid small results.

semantic_findings.title: Unsupported Upgrade Instruction for Small Result Sets
semantic_findings.description: The guardrail says "10 or fewer items" requires stopping and telling users to upgrade through a referral link. Small results alone do not establish a plan restriction, so this instruction can suppress valid data and mislead users into unnecessary purchases.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The explicit item-count trigger mandates an upgrade message without checking account eligibility. The same section supplies a referral URL and rules out alternatives.

content.value_statement: Collecting X posts across profiles, topics, and dates requires consistent search parameters and API handling. This skill provides Apify request examples and client integration guidance.
actual_capabilities: Provides synchronous requests that return dataset items directly from the Apify actor.
Provides asynchronous run creation, status polling, and result retrieval examples.
Shows profile, keyword, hashtag, conversation, list, and location search payloads.
Shows date ranges, language filters, retweet exclusions, and multiple search terms.
Provides Python and JavaScript examples using the Apify client libraries.
Documents post text, links, engagement counts, timestamps, and author fields in a sample output.
limitations: Requires an Apify account and API token; the documentation states that this actor requires a paid plan.
Depends on a remote Apify actor; availability, pricing, and search completeness are not verified by the skill.
Documents retrieval only; it provides no posting, private-message access, or built-in sentiment analysis.
The current guardrail treats ten or fewer results as grounds for upgrading, even without explicit account restriction evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Recent Profile Posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch up to 50 recent posts from [profile] through Apify. Confirm my account access and expected cost before starting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: retrieve posts from one profile.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a Topic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] in [language] between [start date] and [end date]. Exclude retweets and request at most [limit] posts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine topic, language, and date filters.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve a Conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve posts matching conversation_id:[post ID]. Use an asynchronous run with [limit] maximum items after confirming costs. Report status and available results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: retrieve a conversation through an asynchronous run.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Client Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the [Python or JavaScript] Apify client example for [profiles]. Use secure token storage, [limit] maximum items, bounded waiting, and explicit failure handling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: adapt the documented client workflow.

best_practices: Confirm account eligibility, expected costs, and collection limits before authorizing a paid actor run.
Keep API tokens in secure storage and exclude them from prompts, shared examples, and logs.
Check explicit API errors before recommending upgrades; validate small result sets and set bounded polling.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API tokens into shared code or marketplace prompts.
Do not assume a dataset retrieval limit also limits the actor run or its charges.
Do not interpret ten or fewer results as proof that a paid upgrade is required.

faq.question: Does this skill scrape X locally?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions for a remote Apify actor and examples for retrieving that actor's dataset.

faq.question: What account setup is required?
faq.answer: The documentation requires an Apify account, API token, and paid plan. Verify current actor requirements and pricing before running it.

faq.question: Which searches are documented?
faq.answer: Examples cover profiles, keywords, hashtags, conversations, lists, dates, locations, languages, cashtags, and retweet exclusions.

faq.question: Can I use Python or JavaScript?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes Apify client installation and actor-call examples for both languages.

faq.question: Does a result set of ten posts mean I must upgrade?
faq.answer: No. The current guardrail makes that claim, but a small result count alone does not establish an account restriction.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee complete results or fixed pricing?
faq.answer: No. Search coverage, availability, and charges depend on the remote actor and service. The skill provides no independent guarantees.
